A CLEAR PATH THROUGH THE WORK

  1. 01InvestigateFind the cause before recommending the repair.
  2. 02ScopeA written plan for the system, access and trades.
  3. 03RemediatePreparation and installation by one coordinated crew.
  4. 04DocumentPhoto records, QA and a clear project handover.

One scope. Coordinated trades. Clear records.

  1. 01

    INVESTIGATE

    Start with
    the cause.

    Describe the leak or defect, the affected areas and any previous repairs. Share an existing report if you have one. The proposed repair should follow the assessment.

    START THE CONVERSATION
    • The symptoms and affected areas
    • Any existing report or scope
    • Assessment and access requirements
  2. 02

    SCOPE

    Agree
    the work.

    A written scope brings the proposed system, preparation, trades and access together. Discuss the expected program and building restrictions before work starts.

    GET CLEAR ON
    • The proposed repair system
    • The trades and access included
    • The expected program
  3. 03

    REMEDIATE

    Bring the
    trades together.

    Strip-out, screeding, waterproofing, tiling and sealing can be coordinated through the same crew. The work included is set out in your agreed scope.

    COORDINATE THE SCOPE
    • Surface preparation
    • The agreed restoration trades
    • Building and site access
  4. 04

    DOCUMENT

    Leave a
    clear record.

    Photo evidence, QA records and a handover pack help the building understand what was done. Confirm the records and written warranty terms for your project.

    CONFIRM YOUR HANDOVER
    • Project photographs
    • QA records and handover pack
    • Written warranty terms
    Quality & warranty
